meta.title: DevSparks | Online Programming Courses
meta.description: Mentor-led online programming courses for beginners and career switchers. Learn web development, JavaScript, and job-ready skills with live feedback.
meta.ogDescription: Project-based programming programs with mentors, career support, and bilingual instruction in English and Arabic.
meta.keywords: online programming courses, web development bootcamp, learn JavaScript, coding mentors, Arabic programming courses

hero.title: Build real software. Launch a career that actually ships.
hero.lead: DevSparks is a bilingual school for people who want more than video lectures. You write production-style projects, get mentor reviews, and leave with a portfolio you can defend in interviews.

features.title: A studio, not a content dump
features.lead: Every program is designed around shipping, feedback, and habits you can keep after the last lesson.

items.title: Mentor-reviewed code
items.body: You submit real pull requests. Mentors comment on architecture, naming, and accessibility—not only whether it runs.

items.title: Projects that look like work
items.body: Dashboards, APIs, auth flows, and content sites. Your portfolio tells a story hiring managers recognize.

items.title: Bilingual by design
items.body: Learn in English or Arabic. Switch when it helps. Community spaces and office hours exist in both languages.

items.title: Live workshops, async pace
items.body: Two live sessions a week plus recordings. The rest of the work fits around a job or university schedule.

items.title: Career studio
items.body: Resume, GitHub, mock interviews, and a hiring-ready project brief. We treat the job search as a product.

items.title: Accessible classrooms
items.body: Captions, keyboard-first demos, high-contrast materials, and transcripts so nobody is left behind.

courses.title: Courses and pricing
courses.lead: Pick a path that matches your starting point. All prices are billed once per cohort. Scholarships are available after a short application.
courses.currencyNote: Prices in USD. Payment plans on request.

items.name: Web Foundations
items.summary: HTML, CSS, TypeScript basics, Git, and your first accessible landing page.

items.name: Full-Stack JavaScript
items.summary: Next.js, APIs, databases, auth, and a deployable product with tests.

items.name: Career Sprint
items.summary: Polish a flagship project, practice interviews, and ship a public case study.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: If you still need a human, write us in English or Arabic. We reply within two business days.

items.question: Do I need prior coding experience?
items.answer: Web Foundations assumes none. Full-Stack expects comfort with HTML, CSS, and basic JavaScript. We share a short placement quiz after you apply.

items.question: Are classes live or recorded?
items.answer: Both. Workshops are live twice a week, recorded with captions, and paired with async assignments. You can miss a session and still stay on track.

items.question: Can I study in Arabic?
items.answer: Yes. Cohorts run with Arabic and English tracks. Mentors review code in either language. Technical terms stay in English so your GitHub still reads globally.

items.question: What is the time commitment?
items.answer: Plan for 8–12 hours a week, including live sessions. Career Sprint is denser because it is built around interview drills.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: You can withdraw in the first 7 days of a cohort for a full refund, minus payment processing fees. After that we can pause your seat for the next intake.

items.question: Will I get a certificate?
items.answer: Yes, after you complete the required projects. The stronger signal is the public work you ship—we help you document it well.
